**Title:** Where the Memphis Grizzlies stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

- #75 Ty Jerome 54.4
- #84 Cameron Boozer 53.6 (rookie)
- #86 Cam Spencer 53.6
- #160 Cedric Coward 46.5
- #162 Jerami Grant 46.5
- #176 Isaiah Stewart 45.7
- #194 Zach Edey 44.5
- #197 Scotty Pippen Jr. 44.3

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
